summary: Tested (A) session-switcher UI + tab-stickiness on dashboard, (B) backend citation_guard bin_ctx wiring regression suite, and (C) plain chat send + codebase-health/last endpoint access regression. All 30 pre-existing/new backend regression tests pass. All 4 new regression tests pass. Dashboard->Settings->Dashboard navigation preserves the switcher state (session-switcher-btn label 'Chats (6)' stays consistent).
